ns2:course.label: Optimal System Design
ns2:course.description: Fundamental theories for optimal product realization: (1) product planning-demand modeling, customers' preference analysis, and profit modeling under uncertainty; (2) product design-fundamental of engineering optimization theory; (3) product development-analytical problem formulation to achieve the performance targets assigned at the enterprise level and the engineering design level. Core components of modeling, solving, and validating optimization models using quantitative mathematical criteria. Individual or group term project. Prerequisite: GE 330 or IE 310.
